body: Flag: MOSTLY-CLEAN. Tata Sons (unlisted holdco; Tata Trusts ~66%, Shapoorji Pallonji ~18%) controls ~25+ listed firms. Minority record is broadly good: no promoter pledging at listed cos, arm's-length intra-group mergers (Tata Steel absorbing listed subsidiaries; Tata Consumer/Tata Coffee, Tata Motors-TML DVR schemes), and TCS has run repeated buybacks plus high dividend payouts. Tata Motors demerged into passenger (TMPV) and commercial (TMCV) entities in late 2025 with 1:1 mirror shareholding. Blemishes: (1) the Oct-2016 ouster of chairman Cyrus Mistry; NCLAT reinstated him (Dec-2019) but the Supreme Court upheld Tata Sons (Mar-2021) -- legally clean but exposed concentrated trust control; (2) capital allocation misses -- Corus (2007), Tata Teleservices losses and the DoCoMo arbitration, Air India (2022) and its AI171 crash (Jun-2025); (3) 2025-26 trustee infighting: Mehli Mistry not reappointed as trustee (Oct-2025) after a split; Noel Tata vs Venu Srinivasan/Vijay Singh disagreements in 2026. Current status (Nov-2026): RBI classified Tata Sons as an upper-layer NBFC (2022), missed the Sep-30-2025 listing deadline, and on 17-Nov-2026 RBI reiterated it must comply (list); Noel Tata-led trusts resist, SP group pushes for an IPO. A listing would expose the holdco discount at Tata Investment Corp and give SP group an exit. Investor read: listed-company minority treatment strong; holdco/trust politics are the key risk, not fraud.

data.good_conduct: TCS buybacks, no pledges, clean demergers
data.listed_entities: TCS, TMPV/TMCV, Tata Steel, Titan, Tata Power, Tata Consumer, Trent, Indian Hotels, Voltas, Tata Comm, Tata Elxsi, Tata Chem, Tata Investment, Tata Tech, Tata Capital (listed Oct-2025, unverified detail)
data.red_flags: trust-level disputes, Mistry ouster, legacy capital misallocation
data.status_2026: RBI again told Tata Sons to list (17-Nov-2026); trusts split
data.watch: Tata Sons listing decision; SP group exit; trust board composition

title: Tata group (Tata Sons / Tata Trusts) — governance history
